# Model files (generated by `train-model/train.py`)

This folder is empty until you run the training script on Kaggle (with the
`adityajn105/flickr8k` dataset attached) or Colab. After it finishes, copy
the exported files here with this exact layout:

```
model/
  model.json          <- decoder model topology (image features + caption seq -> next word)
  group1-shard*.bin    <- decoder weight shards
  tokenizer.json       <- { word_index, index_word, vocab_size, max_length, start_token, end_token }
  encoder/
    model.json         <- MobileNetV2 feature extractor topology
    group1-shard*.bin   <- MobileNetV2 weight shards
```

Where these come from in `train.py`'s output (`/kaggle/working/`):

- `model_tfjs/*`   -> `model/` (decoder `model.json` + shards)
- `encoder_tfjs/*` -> `model/encoder/` (encoder `model.json` + shards)
- `tokenizer.json` -> `model/tokenizer.json`

The script also prints a `max_length` value at the end — hardcode that
number into the `MAX_LENGTH` constant near the top of `../script.js`
(it controls how many decoding steps the greedy loop runs before giving up).

Until these files are present, the web demo shows a "Model not trained yet"
message instead of trying to load them.
